items.source: The current level refers to the ApplicationContext at the lowest level in the context hierarchy that is visible from the current test.
items.translation: 当前级别 指的是从当前测试可见的上下文层次结构中最低级别的 `ApplicationContext`。

items.source: All ApplicationContexts that reside in a subhierarchy of the common ancestor context will be removed from the context cache and closed.
items.translation: 所有位于公共祖先上下文子层次结构中的 `ApplicationContexts` 都将从上下文缓存中移除并关闭。

items.source: The context cache will be cleared using an exhaustive algorithm that includes not only the current level but also all other context hierarchies that share an ancestor context common to the current test.
items.translation: 上下文缓存将使用一种详尽的算法进行清除，该算法不仅包括当前级别，还包括所有与当前测试共享公共祖先上下文的其它上下文层次结构。

items.source: Defines modes which determine how the context cache is cleared when @DirtiesContext is used in a test whose context is configured as part of a hierarchy via @ContextHierarchy.
items.translation: 定义modes，以确定在使用@DirtiesContext时，当测试的上下文通过@ContextHierarchy配置为层次结构的一部分时，如何清除上下文缓存。

items.source: The ApplicationContext for the current level in the context hierarchy and all contexts in subhierarchies of the current level will be removed from the context cache and closed.
items.translation: 当前级别 的 ApplicationContext 以及当前级别子层次中的所有上下文将从上下文缓存中移除并关闭。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）
